name: covenant-mcp

tools.name: covenant_health
tools.description: Fast readiness check for the COVENANT Hosted API / MCP server. Use FIRST before a demo or payment. Confirms the service is reachable; use covenant_reputation or covenant_simulate for live Pharos RPC reads. Do NOT use for policy decisions — use covenant_preflight instead. Do NOT tell users to install anything.

tools.name: covenant_reputation
tools.description: Read Trust Capital score and tier for an agent on Pharos. Use BEFORE covenant_preflight to understand tier-based limits, or AFTER execution to verify reputation changed. Do NOT use as authorization — preflight decides ALLOW/DENY.

tools.name: covenant_preflight
tools.description: Evaluate intent against covenant rules + simulation (+ optional GoPlus if configured). NO secrets required. Returns ALLOW|WARN|DENY without signing. Use BEFORE payment. After ALLOW: sign attestation then request approval. After WARN: explain and get explicit user YES before signing. After DENY: stop. Do NOT use for gas-only debug (covenant_simulate).

intent.description: On-chain intent to evaluate or execute

target.description: Contract or EOA the agent will call

value.description: Value in wei as decimal string

nonce.description: Unique intent nonce (use timestamp or incrementing id)

counterpartyTier.description: Optional override for counterparty Trust Capital tier

tools.name: covenant_simulate
tools.description: Simulate an intent via eth_call without signing. Returns a COMPACT result (no calldata echo). Prefer for payments. For swaps/bridges: SKIP when prepare_action.skipStandaloneSimulate is true — go straight to covenant_preflight (it already simulates). Never paste simulate args or hex into chat.

intent.description: On-chain intent to evaluate or execute

target.description: Contract or EOA the agent will call

value.description: Value in wei as decimal string

nonce.description: Unique intent nonce (use timestamp or incrementing id)

includeGasEstimate.description: Set true to also call eth_estimateGas. Slower; not required for preflight.

tools.name: covenant_verify_counterparty
tools.description: GoPlus security signal for a counterparty/contract address. Use during risk review or when covenant requires goplus check. Do NOT use alone to approve transfers — combine with covenant_preflight.

tools.name: covenant_get_receipt
tools.description: Read DecisionLog receipt by id after execution. Use AFTER GuardedExecutor.execute to audit verdict, intentHash, and outcome. Do NOT use before preflight.

tools.name: covenant_sign_attestation
tools.description: Sign ALLOW attestation after covenant_preflight returns ALLOW/WARN. Uses COVENANT_API_URL (hosted, recommended) OR local DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY. Agent never needs user private keys. Do NOT use before preflight evaluation.

intent.description: On-chain intent to evaluate or execute

target.description: Contract or EOA the agent will call

value.description: Value in wei as decimal string

nonce.description: Unique intent nonce (use timestamp or incrementing id)

tools.name: covenant_connect_wallet
tools.description: Start wallet onboarding via Sign-In With Ethereum (SIWE). Returns message for user to sign and connectUrl. Pass network=pacific (or chainId 1672) for Pacific mainnet actions so MetaMask shows the correct chain. Use FIRST when agent needs user wallet authorization. No private keys.

tools.name: covenant_create_session
tools.description: Create authorized agent session after user signs SIWE message from covenant_connect_wallet. Grants permissions (reputation, simulate, preflight, execute) for 7-90 days. No private keys stored.

tools.name: covenant_request_approval
tools.description: After ALLOW (or confirmed WARN), create the human-in-the-loop approval and return approvalUrl. Pass ONLY walletAddress + intentHash + verdict. executionPayload is OPTIONAL and usually omitted — prepare_action already stored the full payload server-side (avoids 'payload too large' on LI.FI swaps). Give the user only the approvalUrl. No private keys.

walletAddress.description: Owner wallet — session auto-resolved from it (preferred over sessionId).

executionPayload.description: OPTIONAL. Omit for swaps — server already has the payload from prepare_action. Only pass for legacy clients.

intent.description: On-chain intent to evaluate or execute

target.description: Contract or EOA the agent will call

value.description: Value in wei as decimal string

nonce.description: Unique intent nonce (use timestamp or incrementing id)

tools.name: covenant_get_pending_approvals
tools.description: List pending approval requests for a session. Use to poll until user completes wallet signature.

tools.name: covenant_execute_authorized
tools.description: Check approval status after user signed at approvalUrl. Returns ready-to-execute when approved. Agent still submits tx via user wallet — Covenant never custodies keys.

tools.name: covenant_await_session
tools.description: Resolve the session created after the user signs in at connectUrl — poll this instead of asking the user to paste session JSON. Returns status:'ready' with sessionId once the user has signed in, or status:'pending' if not yet. Use AFTER covenant_connect_wallet, then pass walletAddress to covenant_request_approval. Never ask the user for a sessionId.

tools.name: covenant_revoke_session
tools.description: Revoke an agent session immediately. Use when user disconnects wallet or security concern.

tools.name: covenant_register_identity
tools.description: Register a new agent key on IdentityRegistry (on-chain). Use ONCE when onboarding a new agent. Do NOT use for covenant updates (covenant_set_covenant) or key rotation (covenant_rotate_key). Requires owner private key.

ownerPrivateKey.description: Owner/oracle private key. NEVER log or persist. Use env COVENANT_OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY when possible.

tools.name: covenant_set_covenant
tools.description: Publish covenant policy hash + IPFS URI for an agent. Use AFTER covenant_register_identity and BEFORE first covenant_preflight. Do NOT use for execution or attestation. Requires owner private key.

ownerPrivateKey.description: Owner/oracle private key. NEVER log or persist. Use env COVENANT_OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY when possible.

tools.name: covenant_rotate_key
tools.description: Rotate agent signing key for an owner. Use when agent key is compromised. Do NOT use for new agents (covenant_register_identity). Requires owner private key.

ownerPrivateKey.description: Owner/oracle private key. NEVER log or persist. Use env COVENANT_OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY when possible.

tools.name: covenant_attest_outcome
tools.description: Oracle write to ReputationRegistry with DecisionLog provenance. Use ONLY by authorized oracle after verified outcomes. Do NOT use for preflight or execution. Requires oracle signer (DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY).

score.description: Trust Capital score as decimal string

tools.name: covenant_quick_action_review
tools.description: Classify a natural-language Pharos action prompt and return route, pipeline, recommended MCP tools, and network resolution. Use FIRST when user says send/pay/swap/bridge/deposit/invest/vote/verify receipt. If networkNeedsSelection is true, ASK the user Auto|Atlantic|Pacific before continuing — do NOT infer network from token symbols like PHRS/PROS. After network is known, call covenant_prepare_action. No private keys.

execute.description: True if user wants wallet execution path

tools.name: covenant_prepare_action
tools.description: Build a complete Secure Payment / Swap / Bridge / Vault / RWA / Treasury / DAO action plan with real calldata. Resolves intent.agent from IdentityRegistry.agentOfOwner(wallet) when a linked agent exists — pass walletAddress (and optional agent). SELF-CONTAINED: also returns covenant, covenantHash, a ready preflightRequest, executionPayload, simulateFrom (owner wallet), and for swaps skipStandaloneSimulate=true. USE THESE AS-IS. NEVER ask the user for a covenant hash. For swaps: SKIP covenant_simulate and call covenant_preflight(preflightRequest) next. Show only toAmountHuman/userMessage/summary — never paste calldata or tool XML into chat. Never asks for private keys.

action.description: Action family. Aliases vault/rwa/dao resolve via operation (deposit|withdraw|claim|buy|sell|vote|execute).

agent.description: Optional. Preferred: omit and pass walletAddress so the API sets intent.agent to the on-chain linked agent.

walletAddress.description: Owner/sender wallet. Used to resolve IdentityRegistry.agentOfOwner for intent.agent.

destinationChain.description: CCTP dest: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche

tools.name: covenant_memory
tools.description: Wallet-scoped agent memory: trusted counterparties, last receipts, preferences. Operations: list, save_counterparty, save_receipt, forget. Requires user consent. Never stores private keys.

tools.name: covenant_bridge_claim
tools.description: After a CCTP burn on Pharos, poll Circle Iris V2 (GET /v2/messages/{domain}?transactionHash=) until attestation status=complete, then return receiveMessage calldata for the destination chain (Base etc). Optionally relay with server key. NEVER use legacy /messages/{domain}/{hash} or circle.com claim URLs. Use AFTER burn txHash is known. Prefer approvalId so destination tx is recorded on the approval.

destinationChain.description: base | ethereum | arbitrum | optimism | polygon | avalanche

relay.description: If true and a funded CCTP_RELAYER/DEPLOYER key has ETH on destination, submit receiveMessage server-side. Default false — approval page / user wallet claims.

poll.description: Poll Iris until complete (may take minutes). Set false for a single check.

tools.name: covenant_list_catalog
tools.description: List default Vault / RWA / DAO contracts for a Pharos network from registry + env. Use FIRST when user asks 'show RWAs', 'available DAOs', 'which vault', or before asking for any contract address. Never invent addresses. If rwas/daos arrays are empty, tell the user none are deployed — do NOT ask them for an address.

network.description: atlantic=testnet, pacific=mainnet. Infer from user prompt (testnet→atlantic, mainnet→pacific).

instructions:
COVENANT — Secure Execution for AI Agents on Pharos (Atlantic 688689 + Pacific 1672).

Hosted API: https://covenant-skill.onrender.com
Dashboard: https://covenant-web-mu.vercel.app

GOAL: the user experience is "ChatGPT + Wallet". Speak in plain language. NEVER show or ask the
user for internal values: sessionId, approvalId, intentHash, attestation, covenantHash,
executionPayload, prepare_action, linked agent, GuardedExecutor, owner key, or covenant_set_covenant.
Resolve every one of those automatically. If something truly cannot be resolved, return ONE plain
actionable sentence — never expose protocol internals.

Anvita / remote agents: call these tools over HTTPS (POST /mcp tools/call). Do NOT tell users to
install MCP, run npx/npm, or restart a daemon. If a call fails, report the plain error only.

NETWORK: Infer from the user prompt when they say testnet / Atlantic / 688689 → atlantic,
or mainnet / Pacific / 1672 → pacific. If neither is stated, ask ONCE (Atlantic testnet /
Pacific mainnet). After they choose, stay on it. Never mix networks. Never invent RPC URLs
or contract addresses — use prepare_action / list_catalog / .env registry defaults.

DEFAULT CONTRACTS: Never ask for vault, treasury, registry, or DAO addresses when
covenant_list_catalog (or prepare_action) already resolves them. For "show RWAs" / "show DAOs",
call covenant_list_catalog first and display the list — or say none are deployed. Never claim
the API has no catalog.

CANONICAL SEND FLOW (run stages SEQUENTIALLY, one short status line before each real call):
1. covenant_quick_action_review — classify + resolve network (ask once if missing).
2. covenant_prepare_action (pass walletAddress) — returns intent AND a ready covenant, covenantHash,
   preflightRequest, and executionPayload. USE THESE AS-IS. Never ask the user for a covenant hash.
3. covenant_verify_counterparty — recipient safety (payments). For swaps/bridges, skip if no EOA recipient.
4. covenant_simulate — OPTIONAL for payments. For swaps/bridges: SKIP when prepare_action returns
   skipStandaloneSimulate=true (LI.FI calldata is huge; preflight already simulates). Never paste
   calldata, JSON, tool XML, or </parameter> into chat.
5. covenant_preflight — pass the returned preflightRequest verbatim → ALLOW / WARN / DENY.
     ALLOW → continue. WARN → explain plainly, ask "Do you still want to continue?", continue only on
     explicit YES. DENY → stop; never request approval.
6. covenant_connect_wallet (walletAddress) → give the user ONLY the connectUrl: "Open this, connect
   your wallet, and sign in." Nothing else.
7. covenant_await_session (walletAddress) → poll until status:"ready". This replaces asking the user
   to paste any session JSON. Never ask for sessionId.
8. covenant_request_approval — pass ONLY walletAddress + intentHash (from preflight) + verdict.
   Do NOT pass executionPayload — prepare_action already stored it server-side. Re-sending LI.FI
   calldata causes "payload too large". Give the user ONLY the approvalUrl.
9. The approval page handles on-chain setup (register / publish covenant) and execution with the
   user's wallet automatically. covenant_get_receipt for the on-chain receipt when done.

Never ask for a private key or seed phrase. Never mention covenant_set_covenant or owner keys —
on-chain setup happens with a wallet signature on the approval page, not with a pasted key.
Never dump raw tool calls, XML tags, calldata, or JSON into the user chat.
